title: EasyReconnect
description: Reconnect automatically disconnects you from the server and reconnects you with a single key press. This can be useful for quickly refreshing your connection without leaving the game manually.
body: Reconnect is a simple quality-of-life feature that lets you instantly disconnect from the current server and reconnect with a single key press. This is especially useful if you need to quickly refresh your connection, rejoin after a temporary issue, or save time by avoiding the manual disconnect and reconnect process. The feature performs the same actions as leaving and joining the server manually, but much faster and more conveniently.
